items.text: Irreducible spaces
$X$ is irreducible if $X\neq\varnothing$ and $X=X'\cup X''$ ($X',X''$ closed) implies $X'=X$ or $X''=X$.
$\operatorname{Spec}A=\operatorname{Spec}(A/\operatorname{nil}A)$: take $A$ reduced.
\mathrm X=V(J'J'')\iff J'J''=0;\qquad \mathrm X\ \text{irreducible}\iff A/\operatorname{nil}(A)\ \text{is an integral domain}
Session of 6 June
Points of $\mathrm X$ = prime ideals; residue field $\kappa(x)=\operatorname{Frac}(A/\mathfrak P_x)$.
V(J_1)\cup\dots\cup V(J_n)=V(J_1\cdots J_n)=V\Bigl(\bigcap J_i\Bigr),\qquad \bigcap_\alpha V(J_\alpha)=V\Bigl(\sum J_\alpha\Bigr)
Closed sets of the Zariski (spectral) topology.
V(J)\supset V(J')\iff\sqrt J\subset\sqrt{J'};\qquad \sqrt J=\bigcap_{\mathfrak P\supset J}\mathfrak P
\{k'\text{-points of locus }x\}\ \leftrightarrow\ \operatorname{Hom}_{k\text{-alg}}(\kappa(x),k')
$\mathrm X\neq\varnothing$ is irreducible iff every nonempty open set is dense.
Closed subsets of $\operatorname{Spec}A$
V(J)\ \simeq\ \operatorname{Spec}(A/J)\quad\text{(homeomorphism, topology induced by }\mathrm X)
V(J)\ \text{irreducible}\iff\sqrt J\ \text{prime};\qquad \operatorname{Spec}A\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\{\text{closed irreducible subsets}\},\quad x\mapsto\overline{\{x\}}=V(\mathfrak P_x)
$\operatorname{Spec}A$ is quasi-compact and sober (generic point of a closed irreducible subset); in general not separated.
If $A$ is an integral domain, $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is separated iff $A$ is a field.
Irreducible components
An irreducible component of $X$: a maximal closed irreducible subset. $X$ is the union of its irreducible components.
Every irreducible subset $Y$ lies in a component: take $\overline Y$, apply Zorn's lemma to closed irreducible subsets (the union of a filtering family, then its closure, is irreducible).
\text{irreducible components of }\operatorname{Spec}A\ \leftrightarrow\ \text{minimal primes of }A
$X$ of finite type over $\mathbb C$: $X(\mathbb C)\leftrightarrow\operatorname{Max}(A)=$ closed points of $\mathrm X$. $X$ connected iff $X(\mathbb C)$ connected.
$X$ sober: components $\leftrightarrow$ maximal points for specialization ($x\to y$ if $y\in\overline{\{x\}}$).
